617899.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[ADVENTURE]/[Hero] trait: Cost 0]
[Your Turn] While your opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or more, or your Tamers have 3 or more total colors, this Digimon can digivolve into [WarGreymon] in the hand fora digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
617899.Inherited Effect: [Reboot] (This Digimon also unsuspends in your opponent's unsuspend phase.)

618330.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 2]
[Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Give 2 of your opponent's Digimon [Security A. -1] until their turn ends. (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.)
618330.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.

618819.Description:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Digimon with the [ADVENTURE] trait, gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When any Digimon cards with the [ADVENTURE] trait would be played from your hand, by suspending this Tamer, reduce the play cost by 1.
618819.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.

618820.Description:
[Your Turn] When any Digimon cards with the [ADVENTURE] trait would be played from your hand, by suspending this Tamer, reduce the play cost by 1.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with the [ADVENTURE] trait gain [Blocker]. (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
618820.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.

619680.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 0]
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [ADVENTURE] trait and 1 such Tamer card or Option card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.

619681.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 2]
[On Play] [When Digivolving] If your Tamers with the [ADVENTURE] trait have 3 or more total colors, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [ADVENTURE] trait in the hand without paying the cost.

619682.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 3]
[On Play] [When Digivolving] For the turn, 1 of your Digimon gains [Security A. +1] and for every 2 colors your Tamers have, gets +2000 DP. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your other Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [ADVENTURE] trait, 1 of your Digimon gains [Alliance] for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
619682.Inherited Effect: [Alliance] (When this Digimon attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon gains [Security A. +1] and the suspended Digimon's DP for the attack.)

623019.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 0]
[Opponent's Turn] Your opponent can't reduce digivolution costs.

623020.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 2]
[When Digivolving] If you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 Tamer card with the [ADVENTURE] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
623020.Inherited Effect: [Piercing] (When this Digimon attacks and deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, it checks security before the attack ends.)

623021.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 3]
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon unsuspends. Then, for every 2 colors your Tamers with the [ADVENTURE] trait have, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your other Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [ADVENTURE] trait, 1 of your Digimon gains [Alliance] for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
623021.Inherited Effect: [Alliance] (When this Digimon attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon gains [Security A. +1] and the suspended Digimon's DP for the attack.)

623026.Description:
While you have no face-up [Island of Adventure] security cards, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Security] [All Turns] All of your level 3 or higher Digimon get +2000 DP.
[Main] Add your top security card to the hand. Then, place this card face up as the top security card.
623026.Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost.

623027.Description:
While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [ADVENTURE] trait on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] [Draw 2]. (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your level 5 or higher Digimon would leave the battle area, [Delay]. (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect.)
• You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [ADVENTURE] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
623027.Security Effect: [Security] Place this card in the battle area.

623205.Inherited Effect: [All Turns] This Digimon with the [ADVENTURE] trait gets +1000 DP.

[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, for every 2 colors your Tamers have, their Digimon's effects don't affect 1 of your Digimon.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon.
ACE Overflow "-4" (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
